comment: Copy to ~/.config/herdr-skill/relay.json. It gives the relay worker of this machine. The worker needs a model: from this file, from --model, or from models.json of the herdr skill. Without one, the worker does not start and relay.py exits with 71. Leave thinking out, and the harness uses its own default.
model: <a model name that `pi --list-models` finds one time>
